name: McClelland Acquired Needs Theory
excerpt: McClelland's theory identifies achievement, affiliation, and power as key needs.
notes: McClelland Acquired Needs Theory in motivation identifies three key needs: achievement, affiliation, and power. These needs drive individuals' behavior in a work environment.
